items.caption:
The AI reads documents for you and saves the typing: a photo or a PDF is enough, and the text turns into ready-made entries — deadlines and dates included. Nothing is ever created on its own: you see every suggestion and add it with one tap.

TASKS
Parent letters, notices from school or daycare, letters from authorities, invoices, appointment slips. Whatever has to be done becomes a task — a date found in the text becomes its due date, a looming penalty or reminder makes it high priority.

SHOPPING LISTS
Recipes become articles with quantity and category. You can change the number of servings before adding them, and every amount scales along. A handwritten note or a photographed label works just as well. Recognised ingredients can be kept as a favorite list under a name of your choice — together with their source: the link, or the photo respectively the PDF as a media object below "Rezeptfotos". "Open recipe" shows that original again later.

DATES
Whatever takes place instead of being done — a parents' evening, a course, an outing, a closing day — becomes an appointment in the calendar, with its time and multi-day periods. This needs the OpenCalendar module set up.

popup.caption: Privacy notice for the AI features

items.caption:
WHAT IS TRANSMITTED
Per analysis exactly what you hand over: the photo, the PDF, or — for a recipe link — the text of that page. With the e-mail analysis it is the subject, the mail text and one attachment (PDF or image). Such documents often carry names, addresses, dates of birth or health data; decide before scanning or forwarding whether that is acceptable to you.

WHO RECEIVES IT
The AI provider selected in this section. Anthropic and OpenAI process the data on their servers, outside your home network and possibly outside the EU; their API terms apply. A local server keeps everything inside your own network. If you receive mail through a webhook service (e.g. Mailgun), every mail addressed there — including attachments — passes through that service's servers first; which region processes it is set by the account YOU created there.

WHAT IS STORED
Analysed photos and PDFs are not kept; they exist for the duration of the request. Suggestions extracted from e-mails (sender, subject, the derived entries) stay in this instance for 21 days or until you dismiss them. Mails accepted through the webhook wait unencrypted in a queue on this server until analysed — normally seconds, at most 7 days. The message log records sender and subject of every analysed mail, never its content. Entries you accept live on in your lists and — for appointments — in the calendar connected through OpenCalendar, i.e. with your calendar provider. A recipe saved as a favorite keeps its photo or PDF as a media object below "Rezeptfotos" until you delete that list. API keys stay in this instance's configuration on your server and never reach the apps.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITY
You operate this system, you decide what is analysed, and you choose the services involved — the AI provider and, if used, the mail receiving service. Under the GDPR YOU are the controller for that processing, including documents and mails of other people (family members, letters and senders); contracts and data processing agreements with those services are yours to arrange. The developer of this module receives no data, operates no servers and is not involved in any processing — he provides the software only, and this notice is information, not legal advice. You can withdraw consent at any time: AI analysis and mail acceptance switch off, and mails still waiting in the queue are discarded.

REQUIREMENTS AND COSTS
Your own API key is required. Anthropic and OpenAI charge a few cents per analysis and receive the photo, the PDF or the recipe text. A local server (e.g. Ollama) keeps everything inside your network, but needs a vision-capable model — and one that accepts documents if you want to analyse PDFs. Keys: console.anthropic.com / platform.openai.com. The key is stored in this instance's configuration on your server.
